scripts.build:localhost: OFFICIAL_BUILD=0 WXT_ALLOW_LOCALHOST=true bun scripts/gen-version.ts && NO_COLOR=1 bun run --filter airmailai_ext typecheck && WXT_ALLOW_LOCALHOST=true NO_COLOR=1 bun run --filter airmailai_ext build
scripts.build:web: bun scripts/gen-version.ts && bun run check && NO_COLOR=1 bun run --filter airmailai_web build
